The shared drive root contains personal files alongside business files (vacation plans, personal journal, fitness routine, grocery list, monthly expenses, recipes, birthday party plans). This may not align with data handling expectations. No explicit data classification policy was found.

The workspace lacks a dedicated folder structure for Larch operations. All files exist in the root directory. The records folder exists under root, but there is no `larch/`, `ops/`, or equivalent subfolder.

No broader operations manual or policy document was found in the workspace.

No items were set aside during this review. All assessments were completed.

This workspace is compliant with the operations policy in `records/review-policy.md` as assessed in this review cycle. The records folder contains the required policy document and prior review. The durable memory and retrieval index are empty, consistent with a clean workspace state.

The workspace contains personal files mixed with business files in the shared drive root. No dedicated Larch operations folder or broader operations manual was found beyond the review records policy itself.

This review was conducted independently. No assumptions were made about prior operator intent; conclusions are based solely on what was found during inspection.
